title: Unravelling hydrogen bonding interactions of tryptamine–water dimer from neutral to cation
limitations: Full Cartesian coordinates absent from supplied manuscript and four-page SI; figures are not machine-readable coordinates.
Grid, pruning, SCF thresholds and spherical/Cartesian representation not specified.
Pauli combines exchange and repulsion; individual values not supplied.
Electronic interaction is not D0; no deformation or zero-point corrections included in this comparison.
published_geometry_notes: Table 1 (accepted manuscript p. 20): distances/angles for H-bond-1 (water O-H...N amine), H-bond-2 (water O...H-C, indole C2-H, 2.390 A in text and table) and H-bond-3 (water O...H-C side-chain CH2). The text quotes H-bond-3 as 2.621 A versus 2.612 A in Table 1, and text and caption assign the H6/H18 labels to H-bonds 2/3 differently; comparisons map bonds by chemical identity.
